title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 09] Create shared responsive UI, accessibility and state primitives

red.observed: At the pre-implementation revision d6e3b2d, the project had no test:ui-primitives script and npm reported Missing script: test:ui-primitives.

details: npm ci reproduced the dependency tree without changing package-lock.json.

npm test passed 19 Vitest files and 125 tests, parity matrix 20 routes/53 overlays/8 capabilities, 59 parity negative fixtures, BLDS parity/negative contracts, BLDS SSR rendering, and UI primitive positive/negative contracts.
The final delivery-unit follow-up commit moved the design contract into web/ so the target-version gate accepts the complete Web delivery unit.
The final UI browser run passed 9 Chromium tests: 8 ko/en x 390/1440 x dark/light captures plus the reduced-motion keyboard/focus scenario.
The keyboard regression scenario selected by --grep keyboard passed 1 test.
lint, TypeScript, and the production Next build passed; the build registered /[locale]/ui-primitives.
react-doctor was run with --verbose --scope changed. It reported only existing auth/consent/progress/legal and Zod diagnostics; no new showcase or adapter diagnostic was reported.

surface.runtime: Playwright production webServer: npm run build followed by next start on a credential-free loopback URL
assertions: 390px and 1440px document widths without horizontal overflow
loading, empty, error, unauthorized, consent, quota and offline semantics
localized accessible names, invalid field and described error
Enter/Space activation for button, card and pressable
ArrowRight selection for tab and segmented navigation
snackbar dismissal and observable retry feedback
reduced-motion browser context and package-level motion contract
native-only boundaries for iOS widgets, Siri/App Shortcuts, native push, camera/OCR, share sheet and RevenueCat subscriptions

iteration.initial_visual_review: REVISE: Korean desktop quota title had a lone final syllable and light-theme captures were absent.
iteration.resolution: Added word-break: keep-all, added light-theme capture/assertion coverage for both locales and viewports, strengthened the focus negative fixture, localized the Korean pressable heading, and reran the complete browser matrix.
